preconditions.description: The dimensions of the museum and the number of starting positions are within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(row[0] == '*' and row[-1] == '*' for row in museum)
all(museum[0][j] == '*' and museum[-1][j] == '*' for j in range(m))
all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= m for x, y in start_positions)
preconditions.description: All starting positions are within the museum bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(museum[x-1][y-1] == '.' for x, y in start_positions)
preconditions.description: All starting positions are empty cells.

postconditions.description: The number of output values matches the number of starting positions.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(num, int) and num >= 0 for num in output)
postconditions.description: Each output value is a non-negative integer.
